sections.changelog:
1.66.5 - Rainbow mobile containment guard

  • FIX: adds a final scoped mobile containment override so the two-panel Rainbow showroom stays inside 390px mobile and Edge mobile viewports after the 1.66.4 showroom DNA update.
  • HEALTH: project_3d now reports mobile_containment_v1665 for live deployment QA.

1.66.4 - Rainbow showroom DNA: model plus facade apartment picker

  • UX: keeps the rotating GLB/model-viewer rail as the context model and makes the adjacent fixed facade the primary apartment selector.
  • UX: facade apartment cells now show compact unit/floor and room/area labels, with status colors and recommended-unit pulse retained.
  • UX: selected-apartment card gains a close control and reopens on the next apartment selection, so it no longer permanently blocks the picker.
  • VISUAL: adds project-context pins, a sun arc, improved model camera defaults, centered article headings, and a new compressed Rainbow showroom poster/social image.
  • CMS: one-shot Rainbow poster/social meta seed updates project_model_poster and Yoast social images while keeping unit, lead, payment and schema logic untouched.
  • DOCS: captures the reusable showroom DNA for future Sde Dov and countrywide project pages.

1.66.3 - Rainbow mobile containment and public copy cleanup

  • FIX: restores the mobile showroom edge correction so the Rainbow block stays inside 390px and Edge mobile viewports instead of shifting off-screen.
  • FIX: keeps the selected-apartment scene visible on mobile after a unit click, avoiding the collapsed 2px model stage.
  • CONTENT: one-shot Rainbow cleanup replaces old public internal wording about lead panels with buyer-facing inquiry language and exposes a healthcheck marker.
  • SEO: normalizes same-site Yoast and dynamic og:image/twitter:image URLs to HTTPS so the template gate can pass social-image checks.
  • CACHE: aligns plugin header, healthcheck, manifest and showroom asset cache-busters at 1.66.3.

1.66.2 - Package path hotfix for WordPress updater

  • FIX: rebuilds the NadLan Config ZIP with forward-slash archive paths so WordPress can install the package cleanly on the live Linux server.
  • VERSION: aligns plugin header, healthcheck, manifest, and showroom asset cache-busters to 1.66.2 for unambiguous deploy verification.

1.66.1 - Dual 3D model plus embedded facade apartment selector

  • UX: keeps the real GLB/model-viewer rail as the premium rotating showroom object while rendering a locked facade/elevation selector beside it for precise apartment picking.
  • FIX: embedded apartment cells now render even when a GLB is present, so Rainbow no longer falls back to floating dots or loses the selector path.
  • CMS: facade cell placement now honors stage_x, stage_y, stage_w and stage_h, enabling blueprint/elevation-driven apartment rectangles for future contractor-supplied materials.
  • QA: visual harness now treats .nlp3d-cell as the primary apartment selector and fails if a GLB exists without visible embedded facade cells.

1.66.0 - Embedded apartment-cell selector

  • FEATURE: the showroom now renders each apartment as a clickable CELL embedded on a locked facade plane (no rotation, no floating markers). Cells are positioned in % of the building face so they always sit on the wall; colored by availability (green/amber/grey); selected apartment glows and opens the detail panel.
  • Auto-layout by floor works with zero authoring; new per-unit stage_x/stage_y/stage_w/stage_h fields allow fine placement from the CMS. Rotating CSS tower is hidden in facade mode; scene drag is disabled so apartments never float.
  • Honest scope: true 360-degree rotate-and-click-any-side needs a real per-apartment GLB/BIM model (not yet available); this 2.5D facade selector is the correct shippable step and matches DIGBY / Render Vision / Zillow patterns.

1.65.6 - Rainbow mobile apartment-cell polish

  • FIX: mobile apartment cells now keep 48px+ tap targets and no longer fail the 44px accessibility gate.
  • FIX: selected-apartment details use a controlled mobile sheet instead of collapsing the 3D scene or falling off-screen.
  • HEALTH: project_3d now reports mobile_cell_polish_v1656 for live deployment QA.

1.65.5 - Rainbow apartment-cell selector

  • UX: replaces abstract apartment dots with facade-like apartment cells so buyers understand that each visible unit target is a selectable apartment.
  • UX: keeps status colors, recommended pulse, hover/tap tooltip and the existing selected-apartment card/lead payload wired to the same CMS unit JSON.
  • HEALTH: project_3d now reports apartment_cell_selector_v1655 for live deployment QA.

1.65.4 - Rainbow showroom width fix + apartment-picker polish

  • MERGE: combines the 1.65.3 block-theme full-width fix (alignfull + layout-constrained override so the showroom is not capped at the theme content-size) with the apartment-picker polish branch (SEO intro above the model, clearer clickable apartment markers, dominant selected-apartment card, view-return behavior).
  • Resolves a 1.65.3 version collision between two branches by superseding both with a single aligned 1.65.4 release.

1.65.3 - Rainbow showroom full-width fix

  • FIX: block themes (Twenty Twenty-Five and similar) ship .is-layout-constrained > :where(:not(.alignfull)) which capped the .nlp3d showroom at the theme content-size (often 600-840px), squashing it into a narrow column even on wide desktops. Added alignfull to the wrapper and a belt-and-suspenders CSS override so the showroom reaches its intended width on any block theme.

1.65.2 - Rainbow showroom payload API

  • API: authenticated editors can now export or apply a full project showroom payload through /nadlan/v1/project-showroom/<id>.
  • CMS: the payload route reuses the same sanitized fields as the owner metabox and REST meta contract, enabling future project pages from one data file.
  • HEALTH: project_3d now reports showroom_payload_api_v1652 and the number of showroom payload fields.

1.65.1 - Rainbow showroom REST field contract

  • CMS: the project 3D metabox callback now points directly at the owner-friendly renderer without dead legacy callback code.
  • API: REST-writable project showroom meta now matches the metabox fields, including image, viewBox, floor height, ground elevation, price note and demo flag.
  • HEALTH: project_3d now reports admin_callback_clean_v1651 and rest_showroom_fields_v1651.

1.65.0 - Rainbow admin unit builder

  • CMS: project showroom metabox now groups model, media, pricing, apartment inventory, drawings and surroundings into clear Hebrew sections.
  • CMS: adds a simple apartment unit builder that writes to project_3d_units, keeping raw JSON only for bulk import and advanced editing.
  • HEALTH: project_3d now reports admin_unit_builder_v1650 for deployment verification.

1.64.9 - Rainbow buyer decision card polish

  • UX: selected apartment card now shows buyer-facing tags for recommended, availability, view and price-estimate context.
  • UX: card notes explain whether the price is an estimate, reserved, sold or ready for developer follow-up without leaking internal funnel language.
  • ACCESSIBILITY: active apartment markers now expose aria-pressed and the live healthcheck reports buyer_card_v1649.

1.64.8 - Rainbow mobile viewport edge guard

  • FIX: mobile showroom now measures its live viewport position and nudges itself back inside the screen instead of clipping off the left edge.
  • FIX: model-viewer native hotspot chrome is hidden on small screens so the intended stage apartment markers stay the only buyer targets.
  • HEALTH: project_3d now reports mobile_edge_guard_v1648 for live QA.

1.64.7 - Rainbow tap-select plus drag gate

  • FIX: a tap on an apartment marker selects the apartment even after the marker button enters the drag path.
  • FIX: a drag from the same marker still rotates the building and suppresses accidental click-through.
  • HEALTH: project_3d now reports stage_pick_tap_select_v1647 for the live buyer gate.

1.64.6 - Rainbow stage-pick drag gate

  • FIX: stage apartment marker buttons are now allowed to start model drag gestures while ordinary UI buttons remain protected.
  • HEALTH: project_3d now reports stage_pick_drag_v1646 for the live mobile gate.

1.64.5 - Rainbow mobile marker drag hotfix

  • FIX: apartment marker hit zones no longer block building drag gestures, so buyers can start rotating the showroom from the natural unit-picker area.
  • UX: tap still selects an apartment, while a real swipe suppresses the accidental unit click at the end of the drag.
  • HEALTH: project_3d now reports hotspot_drag_passthrough_v1645 for the live gate.

1.64.4 - Rainbow product marker and mobile drag polish

  • UX: apartment picks now render as clean color-coded product markers instead of tiny text blocks over the model.
  • UX: recommended units pulse, reserved and sold units use distinct status colors, and details stay in hover/card surfaces.
  • FIX: mobile touch drag now uses the same stage camera path as desktop so buyers can rotate the building with a finger.

1.64.3 - Rainbow mobile showroom polish

  • FIX: mobile showroom gets a safe wide stage without right-edge crop.
  • FIX: mobile apartment markers no longer print large labels over the building; details live in the selected-apartment card.
  • FIX: mobile drag uses the stage-level model camera fallback so buyers can rotate the building without fighting model-viewer chrome.

1.64.2 - Rainbow live QA hotfix

  • FIX: contains the Rainbow showroom inside the mobile content column so 390px browsers no longer crop the stage.
  • FIX: restores premium headline contrast on the dark showroom intro panel.
  • FIX: hardens the return-from-apartment-view control against the live map canvas intercepting taps.
  • CACHE: plugin CSS/JS cache-busters move to 1.64.2 for immediate browser refresh.

1.64.1 - Rainbow buyer product selector polish

  • UX: moves the Rainbow showroom back into a buyer-first flow with the SEO intro above the compact model stage.
  • UX: unit pick markers now use color-coded availability dots, 44px+ hit areas, labels, tooltips and optional recommended pulses.
  • UX: selected-unit card now uses buyer actions for full details, apartment view and developer contact.
  • FIX: view-from-apartment scrolls the stage into view and has a capture fallback for the return-to-model button.
  • DOCS: updates the owner manual, 3D model pipeline and premium showroom runbook for clone-ready project pages.

1.64.0 - Rainbow clickable showroom apartment layer

  • FIX: adds a reliable stage-level apartment pick layer over the visible Rainbow tower, wired to the same unit selection state as the console and model-viewer hotspots.
  • FIX: unit selector cards no longer stretch into giant buttons in the buyer console.
  • UX: every showroom pick keeps 44px+ tap targets and updates the existing details, compare, view, and inquiry journey.

1.63.9 - Rainbow first-view stage position

  • UX: raises the visible Rainbow tower higher in the showroom stage so the first buyer viewport shows the building body clearly.
  • CACHE: plugin CSS/JS cache-busters move to 1.63.9 for immediate live verification.

1.63.8 - Rainbow centered showroom view

  • UX: raises the visible Rainbow tower into the main showroom viewport so the first 3D stage reads as a building instead of a low partial shape.
  • UX: suppresses the generic model-viewer hand prompt over the showroom so the page feels branded instead of component-default.
  • CACHE: plugin CSS/JS cache-busters move to 1.63.8 for immediate live verification.

1.63.7 - Rainbow no-blank-stage guard

  • FIX: keeps the procedural architectural tower visible above the model-viewer rail so buyers never see a blank dark showroom if WebGL/model pixels fail.
  • UX: stage drag gestures now rotate the visible tower while model-viewer hotspot buttons remain protected for apartment selection.
  • CACHE: plugin CSS/JS cache-busters move to 1.63.7 for immediate live verification.

1.63.6 - Rainbow visible model hotfix

  • FIX: Rainbow GLB asset is rebuilt with brighter showroom materials and 16-bit indices for safer Chrome/mobile rendering.
  • UX: model-viewer now declares neutral lighting, exposure, camera target, and softer shadows so the tower reads clearly on the dark showroom stage.
  • CACHE: plugin CSS/JS cache-busters move to 1.63.6 so browsers do not reuse the blank 1.63.5 stage.

1.63.5 - Rainbow GLB runtime fix

  • FIX: model-viewer now prints with type="module" through script_loader_tag so the GLB component registers in Chrome instead of throwing Unexpected token export.
  • UX: Rainbow GLB reveal now uses auto loading/reveal behavior with poster fallback, auto-rotate, and full orbit controls so the buyer sees the building without a first click.
  • SEO: the 3D showroom opening copy now starts with project substance: apartments for sale in Rainbow Tel Aviv, Sde Dov, Israel Canada, and non-binding price availability language.
  • CMS: structured surroundings JSON with layers/items is flattened into safe material cards, so future Sde Dov/project environment data can be added without losing fields.
  • HEALTH: project_3d now exposes model_viewer_module_tag=true and model_viewer_reveal=auto for the live gate.

1.63.4 - Rainbow page SEO gate closure

  • SEO: Rainbow project title now leads with buyer intent for apartments for sale and prices instead of only the 3D experience.
  • SEO: meta description now includes non-binding reported-price language for the Rainbow page.
  • CONTENT: one-shot Rainbow SEO seed adds a natural visible buyer phrase and stores editable Yoast title/meta fields.
  • HEALTH: project_page_assembly reports rainbow_seo_v1634 plus title/description override markers for the deploy gate.

1.63.3 - Rainbow showroom contact rail polish

  • UX: while the Rainbow showroom is in view, the floating WhatsApp, call, accessibility and AI controls become a compact edge rail instead of covering the apartment model.
  • ACCESSIBILITY: the rail keeps keyboard focus, 52px tap targets, hover/focus labels, safe-area offsets and reduced-motion support.
  • HEALTH: project_3d now reports floating_action_rail_v1633=true for the deploy gate.

1.63.2 - Rainbow unit REST CMS wiring

  • CMS: project_3d_units is now REST-writable for authenticated editors, closing the last manual paste step for project showroom unit payloads.
  • SAFETY: REST, admin save and frontend rendering now share the same unit sanitizer, preserving only approved unit, price-note, floorplan/tour and model-hotspot fields.
  • HEALTH: project_3d now reports unit_meta_rest=true so deployment scripts can prove when automated unit wiring is safe.

1.63.1 - Rainbow showroom tap-target polish

  • FIX: facade apartment outlines are now visual-only while larger transparent hit areas handle click and keyboard selection.
  • FIX: decorative tower floor bands are no longer exposed as tiny buttons; only unit-bearing floors are selectable.
  • ACCESSIBILITY: late showroom/mobile overrides force stage, compare, tool, advisor and return controls back to 44px minimum targets.
  • HEALTH: project_3d now reports tap_target_min_px=44 for the deploy gate.

1.63.0 - Rainbow real 3D model-viewer showroom rail

  • NEW: project showrooms can now render a real GLB model through Google model-viewer when project_model_glb is supplied, while preserving the existing procedural/facade fallback when no model exists.
  • NEW: project CMS fields for GLB, optional USDZ AR model, and poster image, plus per-unit model hotspot_position, hotspot_normal, and camera_orbit fields.
  • UX: model hotspots select the existing apartment state, so comparison, inquiry, analytics and lead payloads stay unified instead of creating a second selector.
  • SAFETY: fallback tower/facade remains visible until the GLB loads, and stays usable if the model fails.
  • DESIGN: includes the first-screen showroom polish from 1.62.1: static featured-image suppression, stage-first layout, full 360 drag, floating-action clearance, and scoped article typography guards.
  • DOCS: adds a reusable 3D model pipeline skill for future Sde Dov and countrywide project replication.

1.62.0 - Rainbow product showroom CMS upgrade

  • UX: Rainbow 3D now behaves more like a product showroom: building-first stage, drag tilt/rotate, zoom controls, wider facade hit targets, no nested console scrollbars, and clearer mobile stacking.
  • CMS: exposes project material fields for model type, sales video, interior/3D tour, future Cesium/Google 3D Tiles, drawings JSON, surroundings JSON, and per-unit interior/tour/view notes.
  • DATA: environment, media, drawings, and optional non-binding price context stay data-driven and source-note aware, so future projects can clone the same showroom without inventing official plans or availability.
  • DOCS: updates the project showroom runbook and QA notes for Zillow-style replication across Sde Dov and countrywide projects.

1.61.1 - Rainbow render hotfix

  • FIX: Rainbow 3D no longer splits the existing project profile card opening tag, which caused visible class="nlpf" text and made the static card disappear on the live page.
  • FIX: contains the 3D buyer console height on desktop, tablet, and mobile so the page does not push the article headline thousands of pixels down before the project content.
  • FIX: the stage selected-unit card is hidden until an actual unit selection, docks to the side when shown, and no longer steals facade clicks or model-drag gestures.
  • QA: live browser hard-refresh confirmed the defect was real on v1.61.0 and not a cache issue; 1.61.1 is a surgical render hotfix only.

1.61.0 - Rainbow premium showroom, SEO seed, and WhatsApp lead bridge

  • UX: Rainbow 3D now inserts before the old static profile card, opens as a stage-first showroom, and keeps supporting text below the app instead of burying the interactive buyer experience.
  • SEO: adds a one-shot Rainbow content/meta seed with sourced price context, FAQ JSON, amenities, official-site links, and visible buyer/investor context for the project page.
  • LEADS: adds a secret-gated WhatsApp lead-ingestion endpoint that can bridge WhatsApp/shortcut/API messages into the existing NadLan lead rails instead of losing chats outside the funnel.
  • FIX: project quote buttons now use wp_add_inline_script instead of printing raw JavaScript inside content, preventing visible script fragments and texturizer breakage.
  • MAP: sets the Mapbox RTL text plugin before map initialization so Hebrew labels render correctly where supported.
  • DOCS: captures the premium showroom runbook and clone standard for future Sde Dov and countrywide project pages.

1.60.6 - Rainbow 3D runtime hotfix

  • FIX: declares the selected-detail panel before binding the stage details button, so the Rainbow selector boots fully and renders floors, units, drag, and stage actions.
  • FIX: guards the optional Mapbox 3D-building extrusion layer when the active style has no composite building source, preventing non-fatal map style errors from surfacing during the apartment view.

1.60.5 - Rainbow building-first app selector

  • UX: Rainbow 3D opens on the building selector by default again; the live Mapbox apartment view loads only after the buyer asks for it.
  • UX: selected-unit details now appear on the main stage as an app-style card with price/status/view and details/view/next-step actions.
  • DESIGN: removes forced nested scrollbars from the 3D console and tightens the module into a cleaner app layout across desktop and mobile.
  • UPGRADE: tower floors use a cleaner tapered stack with floor labels and active unit markers instead of the older math-wave silhouette.
  • DATA: optional non-binding price estimates can be entered from project average price per sqm or per-unit estimate, with source note and disclaimer behavior.
  • DOCS: captures the building-first clone standard and cost-aware Mapbox behavior for future Sde Dov/countrywide projects.

1.60.4 - SEO schema enrichment

  • NEW: ApartmentComplex JSON-LD on project pages now emits geo coordinates, hero image, description, amenityFeature list (meta: amenities, comma-separated), sameAs official site links (meta: official_site_url), containedInPlace from the nadlan_compound term, and an AggregateOffer price range (meta: price_range text + price_min/price_max numbers) - all data-driven, nothing invented.
  • NEW: FAQPage JSON-LD from meta project_faq_json ([{"q":"...","a":"..."}]) for AI-overview/rich-result eligibility.

1.60.3 - Rainbow big-stage Mapbox hotfix

  • FIX: view-from-apartment now opens in the main 3D stage instead of the narrow buyer console, so the Mapbox canvas is proportional and no longer appears as a 282px side sliver.
  • FIX: Rainbow 3D layout targets the actual .nlp3d-premium wrapper and keeps the stage, console, and live map inside the viewport at desktop and mobile widths.
  • UPGRADE: tower model reads more like a building with a podium base, crown, stronger window rhythm, and edge highlights.
  • FIX: review-form JavaScript moved to wp_add_inline_script so WordPress texturizing cannot turn && into an invalid script on project/profile pages.
  • DOCS: captured the stage-map gate plus the next-slice notes for floating actions and multilingual cloning.

1.60.2 - Rainbow flagship page

  • FIX: live view-from-apartment map no longer stays hidden when Mapbox token and project coordinates are present; the map container is unhidden, resized, and not hidden by non-fatal Mapbox style warnings.
  • UPGRADE: Rainbow project 3D now has a final premium flagship layout layer, selected-unit dock, stronger 360 inspection affordance, capability band, and project-owner request form using the existing lead route.
  • SEO: scoped project-3D title/meta description for interactive project pages.
  • DOCS: clone standard for future Sde Dov/countrywide project pages and compound-map linkage.

1.60.1 - live view polish

  • FIX: dragging the live view-from-apartment map did nothing because cooperativeGestures forced ctrl+scroll / two-fingers. Removed.
  • NEW: NavigationControl with compass + pitch indicator + zoom buttons inside the live view.
  • NEW: live view opens automatically when the project has lat/lng and the Mapbox token is configured (no longer behind a button discovery).
  • UX: 3D badge "3D חי · גרירה לסיבוב" + bottom legend strip with camera altitude/bearing, taller frame (340px), polished controls styling on dark background.

1.60.0 - fully interactive buyer experience

  • FIX: floor strip was empty since 1.59.0 (Set-to-array bug) - floor navigation now works.
  • NEW: live view from the apartment - when a Mapbox token is configured, the view panel renders a real 3D camera at the unit's computed altitude and facade bearing (lazy-loaded, honest fallback otherwise).
  • NEW: אור ושמש tool - astronomical direct-sunlight windows per unit (summer/winter solstice, Israel time), validated against NOAA solar data.
  • NEW: compare up to 3 apartments side-by-side incl. sun hours, with persistent selection (localStorage).
  • NEW: two-step lead wizard with progress dots and multi-select professional accompaniment (lawyer/mortgage/inspection/designer), all riding the lead payload.
  • NEW: floor-plan lightbox, live deal-step tracker after submit incl. reference id, plate hover affordances and scene depth vignette.

1.59.2 - Rainbow 3D visual follow-up

  • FIX: resolves the owner screenshot issue where the Rainbow 3D module was cramped and cropped on the left.
  • UPGRADE: cleaner responsive two-zone layout, contained facade art, clearer tower-plus-boutique SVG concept, floor bands, and apartment bays.
  • DATA: unit model now supports building, availability, note, market_note, and source_note, with those fields passed through leads, owner routing, and non-binding offer tracking.
  • DOCS: adds Madlan-style mapping notes for safely turning authorized project/sales rows into project_3d_units without publishing paid-source rows blindly.

1.59.1 - Rainbow 3D product hotfix

  • FIX: project 3D picker now inserts immediately after the project profile header instead of after the long article body.
  • UPGRADE: tower plates are clickable, demo mode includes an original clickable facade SVG, and real project images can use SVG unit polygons through the existing CMS contract.
  • BUYER JOURNEY: unit drawer now includes spec, drawing, advisor, purchase-check steps, non-binding legal copy, and a clearer purchase-check CTA.
  • DATA: project 3D leads now persist unit, floor, rooms, sqm, budget, timeline, advisor, reservation state, view bearing, and view altitude.
  • SEAM: when offers are enabled, purchase checks create a private non_binding_inquiry offer record with amount 0 for the future purchase screen.

1.59.0 - Rainbow 3D premium project picker

  • UPGRADE: project 3D module now renders a premium blueprint-style pseudo-3D tower picker with floor selection, unit selection, drag-to-rotate, view-from-unit mode, angle controls, orbit mode, and selected-unit fact panel.
  • Lead flow: callback and non-binding purchase-intent CTAs post to the existing /nadlan/v1/lead route with card_id, unit, floor, rooms, sqm, source=project_3d, and purchase_intent metadata.
  • Safety: demo units no longer publish fake prices. Illustrative mode labels itself clearly and renders prices as לפי פנייה until official owner/developer inventory is supplied.

1.58.1 - compound seed

  • NEW: idempotent Sde Dov compound seed. When the compound map flag is enabled, admin init ensures the sde-dov term exists and assigns the existing Rainbow project to it if found. No posts are created and no other terms are touched.

1.58.0 - compound 3D map

  • NEW: dark-launched Sde Dov-style compound fly-over map behind nadlan_feature_compound_map. Adds [nadlan_compound_map], Mapbox GL JS lazy loading, 3D building extrusion fallback, drone camera intro, project pins from nadlan_compound + lat/lng meta, and auto-embed on compound archives.
  • Safety: Mapbox token is stored only as an admin option, never in code. Missing token shows a friendly RTL notice instead of loading broken JavaScript. Healthcheck exposes compound_map enabled/token/pin status.

1.57.1 - compounds

  • NEW: nadlan_compound taxonomy (מתחמים) for grouping projects under a development compound (e.g., Sde Dov) with /compound/ archive, developer+contractor filter bar shortcode [nadlan_compound_filter], paid placement respected, healthcheck compounds block.

1.57.0 - interactive picker + offers + critical fix

  • CRITICAL FIX: three settings pages (NadLan AI, NadLan CTA, Preferred Partners) silently never saved because the submit button had no value attribute. Found by Cowork during activation; all three fixed and audited.
  • NEW (dark, nadlan_feature_project_3d): interactive apartment picker - clickable SVG units over the project render, RTL unit panel, lead CTA into the existing funnel, demo mode, admin metabox for render URL + units JSON.
  • NEW (dark, nadlan_feature_offers): non-binding price offers - per-card enable + minimum + transparency mode (sealed/leading), anti-sniping 24h window extension, phone dedupe, honeypot + 5/hour rate limit, owner notification. No success fee by design.
  • Concierge widget reframed: 'מענה מהיר' with honest human-review line (every conversation reviewed by a human rep).

1.56.1 - activation prep

  • NEW: Settings -> NadLan Features, master switchboard for all five dark features (the admin_control and help flags previously had no visible toggle when off).
  • Healthcheck now exposes a feature_flags block.
  • Marketing copy refresh on the homepage advertiser tile and the sponsored slot: benefit-led wording plus the free-for-limited-time listing promo.

1.56.0 - Chunk F contextual help framework

  • NEW: dark-launched in-app contextual help behind nadlan_feature_help, default off.
  • When enabled, Nadlan admin screens can use a single filterable help string store for accessible field tooltips, contextual Help tabs, WP pointer tours, and reusable empty states.
  • Safety: no frontend impact, scripts and styles lazy-load only on opted-in Nadlan admin screens, pointer dismissal uses a nonce and per-user dismissed_wp_pointers storage, and healthcheck exposes help loaded/string counts.

1.55.0 - Chunk E operator admin control

  • NEW: dark-launched operator admin control plane behind nadlan_feature_admin_control, default off.
  • When enabled, operators can validate and edit card city, lat/lng, reference links, and placement weight through a nonce/cap protected admin screen, meta box, and REST path.
  • Placement overrides are separate query-time signals: pinned, reserved slot, boost multiplier, and promo_until. They compose with paid placement and auction ordering and expire through cron.
  • Safety: every write is audited, the nadlan_operator role has nadlan_manage_clients but not manage_options, and view-as-advertiser sessions are time-boxed and read-only unless explicitly unlocked.

1.54.0 - Chunk D automated lead nurture

  • NEW: dark-launched email nurture flow behind nadlan_feature_lead_nurture, default off.
  • When enabled, Chunk B leads schedule score-aware follow-up touches through the existing lead delivery channel: day 1/3/7/14 for hot/warm leads, lighter cold cadence, then monthly win-back.
  • Safety: each touch has an atomic send guard, unsubscribe token, bounded non-PII audit log, and automatic stop on reply, contacted/won/lost status, AI handoff, or unsubscribe.
  • Healthcheck and Ops dashboard now expose lead_nurture scheduled, sent, active, stopped, and stopped-by-reason metrics.

1.53.0 - Chunk C AI lead qualification

  • NEW: dark-launched AI lead qualification behind nadlan_feature_lead_ai_qualify, default off.
  • When enabled with OpenAI, Chunk B leads are scored once, enriched with extracted budget/intent/timeline/location, routed as hot/warm/cold, and can receive a grounded email response through the existing lead delivery channel.
  • Safety: no OpenAI key or flag off means zero AI calls; per-lead token cap plus existing daily caps are checked before provider calls; low-confidence, off-topic, or human-request leads hand off without auto-reply.
  • Healthcheck and Ops dashboard now expose lead_ai qualified rate, average score, and hot/warm/cold counts.

1.52.0 - Chunk B lead end-to-end

  • NEW: dark-launched lead E2E flow behind nadlan_feature_lead_e2e, default off.
  • When enabled, card leads get idempotent capture, visitor acknowledgement, paid-owner routing, admin fallback, advertiser-center status workflow, bounded audit log, response-time metrics, and lead_e2e health/autopilot metrics.
  • OFF behavior remains the existing lead flow.

1.51.2 — AI loader order (Codex verification follow-up)

  • Load ai-provider before ai-features/ai-concierge so the OpenAI provider functions are canonical (removes any definition-precedence ambiguity Codex flagged). Runtime was already safe; this makes the architecture explicit.
  • /health version aligned to 1.51.2.

1.51.1 — consolidation fix (Codex-caught regressions)

  • FIX: AI concierge endpoint + settings now use the OpenAI adapter (nadlan_ai_chat) — the v1.51.0 merge had reverted it to the old Anthropic-only concierge. Grounding/sources-or-abstain/human-handoff restored.
  • FIX: Studio self-serve 'create listing → become advertiser' role assignment restored (lost in the v1.51.0 merge).
